newsitem.title: USA: NAI Technologies Inc director increases holdings.
newsitem.headline: NAI Technologies Inc director increases holdings.

text.p: NAI Technologies Inc said director Charles Holmes has become the indirect beneficial owner of an additional 12,000 shares through the purchase of common stock at a price of $4.50 per share on April 1, and of an additional 5,000 warrants, purchased at a price of $3.26 on April 2.

The purchases brings Holmes' total beneficial holdings to 3,234,000 shares, or 29.4 percent of the shares outstanding, consisting of 1,187,000 shares of common stock and warrants and options to purchase 2,047,000 shares of common stock.
NAI Technologies is an international electronics company that focuses in advanced computer system design and telecommunications.
